data.name: Rafeed
data.gender_notes: Rafeed is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who strives to do good and follow the right path. The name Rafeed carries the meaning “Pursuer of good deeds” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rafeed usually hope their child will grow to embody pursuer of good deeds and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be a follower of the righteous and just
data.etymology: Rafeed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pursuer of good deeds.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rafeed total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: رفيد
in_arabic.meaning: يحمل المعنى من الجذور العربيعة الكرم والحمية والإخلاص
in_arabic.long_meaning: يأتي الاسم الإسلامي رفيد من الجذر العربي رَفَدَ، وتعني كرمًا، ووفرةً، وإخلاصًا في الإيمان، وتعرفه قديمًا في الإسلام، حيث يشير إلى الشخص الخير والطيب، والمحافظ على عادات والديه، وتعكس الاسم الأصلية العربية، وتستخدم في عدة دول عربية، وتعتبر من أسماء الإنجاز والنجاح في الإسلام، ويرمز إلى الشخص الموفق والمحافظ في الدين والإيمان

in_urdu.name: رفید
in_urdu.meaning: یہ نام کرم و وفریگی اور اخلاص کا حامل ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اس نام کا تعلق عربي بانی ناموں سے ہے۔ یہ نام کرم و وفریگی اور اخلاص کا حامل ہے۔ اس کی اہمیت کو دیکھتے ہوئے اسے اسلامی ناموں کی درجہ بندی کے حوالے سے بڑی اہمیت دی جاتی ہے۔ اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بہت عام ہے۔ اس کی بنیادی شائستگی کی وجہ سے کئی مسلمانوں نے اپنی اولاد کے نام کے طور پر اس کا انتخاب کیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रफ़ीद
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम कृम व वफरी और अखलास का है
in_hindi.long_meaning: इस नाम का संबंध अरबी नामों से है। यह नाम कृम और वफरी का है। इस नाम की महत्ता को देखकर इसे इस्लामी नामों की श्रेणी में बड़े महत्व के रूप में जाना जाता है। इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत आम है। इसकी मौलिक शुद्धता की वजह से कई मुसलमानों ने अपने बच्चे के नाम के रूप में इसका चयन किया है।

in_pashto.name: ړفيڅ
in_pashto.long_meaning: ړفيڅ نوم دې نوم د عربي باني نومونو څخه راغلی دی. ړفيڅ نوم خيرمنزې، اخلاص او د اسلامي ځوابويې له منځته راوړي. دا نوم په اسلامي نومونو کې ډاډنې لري، په دې نوم کې د اسلامي ځوابويې پرمهال د خيرمنزې او اخلاص د منځته راوړي. دا نوم په افغانستان کې د اسلامي نومونو کې ډاډنې لري، په دې نوم کې د اسلامي ځوابويې پرمهال د خيرمنزې او اخلاص د منځته راوړي.

in_english.name: Rafeed
in_english.meaning: Connotes nobility, generosity, sincerity, and righteousness
in_english.long_meaning: The Islamic name Rafeed is derived from the Arabic root r-f-d, meaning nobility, generosity, and sincerity. In Islamic tradition, Rafeed is considered a name that connotes righteousness, compassion, and kindness. In Arabic, the name is written as رَفِيد, and it is often associated with the qualities of a noble and generous person. The name has been used in various Islamic contexts, including the Quran, where it appears as a name of a prophet. In modern times, the name Rafeed has been adopted by Muslims around the world, symbolizing the values of kindness, generosity, and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rafeed holds significant cultural values in the Islamic community. In Arabic, Rafeed comes from the root word "rafda" which translates to "strive", "exert effort", or "keep attempting". The name is associated with individuals who are determined to excel in their personal, academic, and professional lives, making a positive contribution to their communities. This mindset is widely embraced and celebrated in the Islamic culture as a means of promoting personal progress and societal development.
data.spiritual_significance: Moreover, from a spiritual perspective, Rafeed evokes the concept of self-improvement, diligence, and focus on the hereafter. In Islamic teachings, every person is encouraged to strive for the sake of Allah and make an effort in their religious practice. The name Rafeed acts as a constant reminder for the person to take steps towards self-refinement and staying on the righteous path. It also imparts a sense of responsibility and accountability to the individual, inspiring them to work towards their spiritual growth and become a vehicle for positive change in the world around them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Pursuer of good deeds" symbolizes One who strives to do good and follow the right path. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rafeed serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of pursuer of good deeds.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rafeed was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Rafeed carried significant weight in that era.
